short.q: Describe the main features of a typical pop song structure.
short.model: Intro, verses, repeated chorus with a hook, a contrasting bridge, and an outro; often a four-chord loop.

short.q: Explain how a leitmotif can show a change in a character.
short.model: The theme returns but is changed, e.g. minor key, slower, different instrument, showing a change in the character or situation.

short.q: Name two production effects used on a vocal and describe each.
short.model: Reverb gives the sound of a large space; delay repeats the sound as an echo; auto-tune corrects pitch.

short.q: Give two differences between diegetic and non-diegetic music.
short.model: Diegetic is heard by the characters and comes from the film world; non-diegetic is the score added for the audience only.

short.q: Describe two typical features of jazz.
short.model: Swung rhythms and syncopation, improvisation, walking bass, extended chords.
